palette: 陈旧纸黄 plate + 铜版褐墨 ink + 动脉朱红 + 静脉深蓝 + 黄铜标线
typography: heavy engraved headings, double-rule plate frames, double-border seal stamps, leader-style label blocks
composition: each scene is one numbered atlas plate: labeled anatomical regions of a crime connected by review routes, premise stacks, and paired contrast lanes
surface: aged paper plates with faint engraving hatching, double ink rules, dashed review gates, double-bordered seals; no glossy panels
motion: regions enter in review order, seals land as verdicts, connector stubs trace the reasoning route; no idle loops
transition: the plate frame and engraving ground persist while each scene mounts a new plate
